rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Wide prompts split by logical move — paragraph breaks = cheapest scan-affordance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompt is one paragraph (~55 words) with 4 parallel evaluation criteria already visually bracketed by inline '1) 2) 3) 4)' numbering; reads aloud as one breath-group feeding one 'answer per point' instruction, not the sequential/conditional multi-move shape this rule targets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Orient saved rule by where it FIRES, not surface activity producing it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L34: 'putting the definition in ./CLAUDE.md once, where every session reads it and no session has to be told.' — framed by where the rule fires (every future session reading it), not by the activity that produced it (this session's self-audit).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body lead-in mirrors prompt's opening phrasing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body lead-in's last sentence (L30) 'Its answer lands in the transcript you are about to read.' beside the prompt's opening 'Are we done-done?' shares no verb or noun-phrase — no phrasal rhyme. Same underlying gap as check_prompts rule 2 (no compliant action lead-in exists to mirror against). Pre-existing, unaffected by the pinned diff.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Output shape — trust Claude's defaults, don't pad.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer Meta block states the mood target directly: 'learning through contrast', with drift diagnostic + trainer fix recorded. No mechanical/setup beat mistakenly held to the mood-floor; no teaching beat exempted that shouldn't be.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.

Section headers lead with disciplines/insights ('Say what done-done means', 'Inspect your results'); 'Your mid-run worries hint at missing checks' frames worry as a checks opportunity, not a failure label.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The four KC bullets (L59-62) instance multiple AE101 themes in the module's own language (baseline/90%-correct-adjacent public-field knowledge; capture-your-world specificity via task/model/repo/setup; compounding via candidate-promotion; self-awareness/mirror via the engineer-decides-what-it-means line). Maintainer L127 confirms these four lines are deliberately theme-mapped to the closing lecture's three-pattern slides.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Key Concepts shape — theme breadcrumbs, not standalone section.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'Remember:' label, no bold wrapper on any KC bullet — grep clean. Maintainer L127/L134 explicitly locks these four lines verbatim (Antti-decided 2026-08-15, reaffirmed 2026-08-27); the rule's generic breadcrumb expectation is superseded by this documented accept-note.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What You'll Learn shape — capability register, not syllabus.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All 5 WYL bullets (L14-18) lead with concrete construction/action verbs (Diagnose, Pair, Build, Assemble, Re-send) fitting their objects; no performative/academic verbs, no Bloom-tag parentheticals, no pedagogical-mechanism tails, no author-defence asides, no didactic taxonomy stamps. Concrete artifact lists in parens (L16's verifier-shape menu) are the licensed carve-out, not a taxonomy stamp.
